description: Where each manufacturer caffeine record in AuroraCore/Sources/AuroraCore/Resources/caffeine-db.json came from. Values are copied from the maker's own website or label only; no aggregators, retailers or encyclopedias. Rule (CPO, Nov 10): store one published number for one exact product and serving, or store nothing; never pick between numbers, average or scale them. A brand without exactly one explicit mg value for the serving on a manufacturer page has no record and shows Not in Database. A record is used only at its recorded serving; any other size falls back to Not in Database and manual entry. Merge into the database with scripts/merge-manufacturer-caffeine.py (no network).
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AuroraResearch/1.0 (curl); headless Google Chrome for script-rendered pages
robots: robots.txt read for every host on 2026-11-10; every fetched path is allowed.
